questionText:
Which among the following was not a part of the resolution adopted by the
United Nations General Assembly in 1992?

options.text: The Security Council no longer represents contemporary political realities
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: The decisions of the Security Council reflect global values and interests
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for International Organisations.

options.text: The Security Council lacks equitable representation
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: The Security Council is dominated by a few powers
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For International Organisations (International Organisations in a Changing World):
In 1992, the UN General Assembly adopted a resolution expressing three complaints: (1) The Security Council no longer represents contemporary political realities; (2) Its decisions reflect only Western values and interests and are dominated by a few powers; (3) It lacks equitable representation. Thus, claiming it reflects 'global values' was NOT part of the resolution.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

(A) India is one of the most populous countries in the world, comprising almost one-fifth of the world population.
(B) India is also the world's largest democracy and has participated in almost all the initiatives of the UN.
(C) Though India's role in the UN's peacekeeping efforts is a long and substantial one, it has faltered in its financial contributions to the UN.

detailedSolution:

Thus, (A), (B), and (D) only are correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Abolishing or diluting the veto power of the permanent five members of the UN Security Council is practically impossible to achieve legally.
Reason (R): Under the United Nations Charter, any constitutional amendment to the Charter itself requires the affirmative ratification of all five permanent members.

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

detailedSolution:

Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) explains the legal catch-22—under Article 108 of the Charter, any amendment must be ratified by all P5 members, who will veto any measure stripping them of their veto.
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct choice.
